editorialDecisions.detail: Translated49unique Japanese paragraphs,7lesson metadata and7question sets directly from isolated canonical Japanese. Seven explicitly empty readings retained. No other locale input.

Kept observed speech/action versus measured vital signs, planned versus measured, confirmed versus unconfirmed near-miss cause, medical reporting recipient and facility/individual-plan limits. Preserved vocabulary context and reference-list purpose.

Preserved contact/droplet/airborne classification limits, standard precautions before diagnosis, task-specific PPE rather than universal full kit, glove changes and post-removal hygiene, both-hand coverage, product-specified rub quantity/dry completion, visible-soil soap/water requirement and recontamination risk. No new chemical recipe or duration added.

Retained trained-method/equipment/personnel boundaries, no manual-lifting authorization from stance alone, sheet versus board, staff rest/health reporting, disaster-specific plans and individualized powered-device/contact preparation without changing oxygen settings.

Kept signed language versus gestures, listening/empathy/acceptance distinctions, open-versus-closed question burden, since-yesterday time meaning, culture and personal preference, consent after benefits/disadvantages information and actual choice versus nodding. Art captions retain contextual limits.
